findings.fact: Continuous mouse input resets the five-second extension timer. Keyboard and scroll activity bindings are absent.
findings.consequence: The previous continuous-input predicates are no longer implemented on this branch.
findings.next_action: Run the three browser predicates. Record any scope exclusion through an explicit business decision.

findings.fact: relogin returns no HTTP completion promise. Timeout closes after awaiting that void return.
findings.consequence: A held or rejected service request can lose its prompt and retry opportunity before completion.
findings.next_action: Execute held-response and rejection cases. Do not treat narrower code scope as acceptance.

findings.fact: Refresh expiry still opens timeout. The branch SR11 test expects logout despite 23 successful activity extensions.
findings.consequence: This source and its test oracle conflict with unchanged candidate-v4 continued-activity intent.
findings.next_action: Retain the browser result. Resolve whether the minor scope explicitly excludes continuous renewal across initial refresh expiry.
findings.limit: Short refresh fixtures can reacquire credentials before the initial boundary. Predicting one specific browser result requires its timing evidence.

findings.fact: Each extension call aborts the prior controller. Home unmount and timeout no longer abort pending activity requests.
findings.consequence: Slow shared requests and stale responses lack the guards exercised by the earlier E2E expansion.
findings.next_action: Run single-flight, logout cancellation, and late-response predicates. Keep their exact failures separate.

findings.fact: Successful HTTP extend/relogin responses install authorization without checking the response result field.
findings.consequence: The controlled negative-body and valid-header diagnostic is expected to fail.
findings.next_action: Confirm whether that response combination can occur before treating a diagnostic failure as a release defect.

findings.fact: The minor patch retains refresh credentials across access rotation and shares same-token refresh acquisition.
findings.consequence: Visibility-time acquisition improves the retained eligible-refresh path. It does not correct manual completion or continuous activity.
findings.next_action: Evaluate natural recovery together with the separate prompt-completion result.

findings.fact: The exported extension helper remains callable by Cashflow and Ratan query paths.
findings.consequence: The helper affects consumers beyond portal mouse input. Local portal fixtures do not establish those integration outcomes.
findings.next_action: Bind consumer revisions and inspect representative traffic before a release decision.

findings.fact: The retained unit run failed late-hide refresh recovery at sessionLifecycle.test.tsx:364.
findings.consequence: Delayed refresh arrival can leave the background-return dialog committed to logout with Extend disabled.
findings.next_action: Keep the failure open. Evaluate the matching browser race before accepting the required background fix.
findings.acceptance_limit: No waiver is recorded. A fast-service happy path cannot replace this delayed-response regression.
